name_reason: Name already conforms: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + chapter domain + ch27 (meaningful chapter ID in 01-30 range, not an address residue) + pos_y (element semantics) + table (array datatype). 0x52316 does not appear as a suffix, so no Ghidra address residue. Consistent with sibling end-scene tables in chend2.c (ch20/21/22/23/26/30).
purpose: Chapter 27 end-scene character Y positions: one byte per party slot 0..15, supplying the world-tile Y coordinate each surviving char is placed at during the chapter-27 ending cutscene.
logic_summary: Private read-only const byte[16] referenced only by fd2_chapter_27_end (@0x250CC). The handler prologue copies all 16 bytes onto stack scratch as four dwords (MOVSD x4 -> var_20), then passes the stack buffer as arg2 (pos_y) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which reads it indexed by char slot. Paired with the X table @0x52306 (arg1). No writers anywhere in the binary.
element_semantics: byte[i] = world-tile Y coordinate for runtime char slot i (i = 0..15). Values 0x0B..0x0F (11..15) form a compact cluster matching the ch27 ending-scene formation layout.
